title: Dual Viciss
extract:
Dual Viciss are  Scaldra dual sickles used by Scaldra Flayers. Inflicting  Gas status effects boosts the user's Movement Speed and Attack Speed.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Gas damage.
Inflicting  Gas status effect with this weapon grants a buff that increases Movement Speed by 8% and Attack Speed by 7% for 10 seconds and stacks 5 times.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Carving Mantis,  Crossing Snakes and  Dividing Blades (Conclave only) stance.
Innate  polarity.

Acquisition
Dual Viciss's blueprints can be purchased from Minerva of  The Hex for  Standing; component blueprints for  5,000 and the main blueprint for  15,000 to a total of  35,000, all requiring Rank 5 - Pizza Party.
This weapon is also part of the Scaldra Dominance Pack for  655.

Notes
Bonus Movement Speed and Attack Speed buffs stack additively to weapon mods like  Fury and  Dispatch Overdrive.
Buff refreshes its duration upon gaining a new stack.
When timer runs out, all stacks are lost.
Gives only one stack per melee hit, even if the hit procced more than one gas status. Striking several enemies gives one stack per each enemy.
Activations of Truth via Truth's Flame will trigger a stack of the buff for each enemy affected. {{cite}}
